title: Complexity coverage classification
responsibility: States whether a file’s decision points can be counted, are absent by file kind, or belong to an unsupported language.

inputs.name: complexityCoverage.path
inputs.description: Path of the file to classify; only the lowercased extension of its last segment selects the coverage class, and the file itself is never read. A path with no extension, such as Makefile or the dotfile .gitignore, has an empty extension and is classified as unsupported.

inputs.name: complexityCoverage.scripted
inputs.description: Whether an HTML file carries a script: true makes a .html path unsupported and false makes it declarative, and the flag has no effect on any other extension. It defaults to false.

inputs.name: uncountedLanguage.path
inputs.description: Path of the file to name; only the lowercased extension of its last segment is used, and the file itself is never read. The function does not check that the file is unsupported, so a path with a counted extension such as .ts is named '.ts files'.

outputs.name: complexityCoverage
outputs.description: The coverage class of the file: 'counted' for .ts, .tsx, .js, .jsx, .mjs, .cjs and .svelte; 'declarative' for .css, .json, .toml, .yml, .yaml, .md, .txt, .svg, .lock and .html without a script; 'unsupported' for any other extension, including .html with a script and paths with no extension. 'declarative' means the file declares and does not decide, while 'unsupported' means nothing here reads its language, so its decision points are not counted.

outputs.name: uncountedLanguage
outputs.description: The language name a reader would give the file: a fixed name for .rs (Rust), .py (Python), .sh (shell), .sql (SQL), .go (Go), .java (Java), .kt (Kotlin), .swift (Swift), .c and .h (C), .cpp (C++), .rb (Ruby) and .html ('HTML with an inline script'); otherwise the lowercased extension followed by ' files', or 'files without an extension' when there is none. The label is computed from the extension alone and is not checked against complexityCoverage.
